{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Evaluate probe on original test set (no baselines)."""
import argparse, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from probe_model import ProgressProbe, WindowDataset, collate_fn
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--data_dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--split_info", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=64)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    data = torch.load(Path(args.data_dir) / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)

    with open(args.split_info) as f:
        si = json.load(f)
    test_idx = si["test_indices"]
    keep = si.get("keep_indices")
    if keep is not None:
        data = {k: [data[k][i] for i in keep] if isinstance(data[k], list) else data[k]
                for k in data}

    ckpt = torch.load(args.checkpoint, weights_only=False, map_location=device)
    model = ProgressProbe(
        embed_dim=ckpt["embed_dim"],
        hidden_size=ckpt["hidden_size"],
        num_layers=ckpt["num_layers"],
    ).to(device)
    model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model_state_dict"])
    model.eval()

    test_ds = WindowDataset(
        [data["embeddings"][i] for i in test_idx],
        [data["labels"][i] for i in test_idx],
    )
    loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, collate_fn=collate_fn)

    all_labels, all_preds = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for padded, labels, lengths in loader:
            logits = model(padded.to(device), lengths)
            preds = (torch.sigmoid(logits) >= 0.5).long().cpu()
            all_labels.extend(labels.long().tolist())
            all_preds.extend(preds.tolist())

    metrics = {
        "macro_f1": f1_score(all_labels, all_preds, average="macro", zero_division=0),
        "accuracy": accuracy_score(all_labels, all_preds),
        "f1_stagnation": f1_score(all_labels, all_preds, pos_label=0, zero_division=0),
        "f1_progress": f1_score(all_labels, all_preds, pos_label=1, zero_division=0),
    }
    print(f"Test windows: {len(test_idx)}")
    for k, v in metrics.items():
        print(f"  {k}: {v:.4f}")
    # JSON output for parsing
    print(f"METRICS_JSON={json.dumps(metrics)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
